title: Find K Closest Elements
summary: Given a sorted array of integers, find and return the k integers closest to a given value x, sorted in ascending order.
statement: Given a sorted array of integers, find and return the k integers closest to a given value x, sorted in ascending order. An integer is closer to x if it has a smaller absolute difference or, if the differences are equal, it is smaller in value.
constraints: Return k closest values in ascending order; equal distances favor the smaller value.
hints: The k closest values form a contiguous window in sorted order.
Binary-search the window start by comparing its excluded boundary candidates.
If x-left > right-x, move the window right; otherwise keep the left side.
The boundary comparison is monotone across window starts and naturally applies the smaller-value tie break.
editorial: The boundary comparison is monotone across window starts and naturally applies the smaller-value tie break.

tests.explanation: The four closest values are one through four after the smaller-value tie break.
When x lies left of the array, the first four values are closest.
